entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working correctly.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. The heart rate reading is all over the place, and it won't sync half the time. Honestly, the thing is just garbage.

I understand how frustrating that must be. Inconsistent readings can definitely disrupt a workout. I can transfer you over to our technical support team; they have a few quick steps that can usually resolve syncing and accuracy issues right away.
No, I really don't have time for that. I've already wasted enough time trying to get it to work. I just want my money back. Can we please just process the refund?

I understand you'd prefer a direct refund. Looking at your account, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 12 days ago. For this specific device, we have a strict 10-day return policy for preference-based returns.

But it's not a preference, it's broken. Only 10 days? I'm just so disappointed. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for this. I really needed this money if the product wasn't going to work as advertised.

I truly do understand your position. For a defect claim outside the 10-day window, our process requires that we first verify the fault with our technical team. Without that verification, I'm unable to override the policy.
So you're saying I'm stuck with it unless I want to spend another hour on the phone with someone else? This is really disheartening.

The policy for the VeloBand Pulse is tied to hygiene protocols and the device's activation to a user's account, which is why the window is firm. The path to a resolution for a faulty device is through our technical support. If they verify a hardware defect, they can authorize a replacement under its warranty. I can still transfer you if you'd like.
No, I don't want a replacement. I just wanted a refund. I guess there's nothing you can do. Thanks for nothing.

I am very sorry we couldn't resolve this differently for you today. If you do decide you'd like to troubleshoot for a warranty replacement, please feel free to call us back. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
